
Named graphs, under `https://worklode.io/ns/graph/`: `project/<project-id>`, `declared/<doc-key>` (a document's current state), `declared/<doc-key>/v<n>` (one immutable version), `observed/<source>` (server-side derivers: `deploy`, `pr-affects`) and `observed/<source>/<host>/<owner>/<name>` (repository-local derivers run by `lode graph derive`).
